installation_issues_and_workarounds.issue: Blender discovery fails with exit code 1 when Blender is installed in a non-system user directory and neither PATH nor BLENDER_EXECUTABLE is configured.
installation_issues_and_workarounds.error: Blender executable not found. Set BLENDER_EXECUTABLE or add blender to PATH.
installation_issues_and_workarounds.root_cause: shared/runner.py only checks explicit arg, BLENDER_EXECUTABLE, PATH, and standard Linux paths (/usr/local/bin/blender, /usr/bin/blender, /snap/bin/blender).
installation_issues_and_workarounds.workaround: Export BLENDER_EXECUTABLE=/home/spark/opt/blender-5.2.4-linux-x64/blender (or prepend its directory to PATH).
installation_issues_and_workarounds.proposed_improvement: Document BLENDER_EXECUTABLE prominently in README Quick Start and optionally probe $HOME/opt/blender* or persist a verified binary path during install.

installation_issues_and_workarounds.issue: Container workspace filesystem (/working_dir) stripped shared libraries (.so) after extraction, causing Blender subprocesses to fail with exit code 127 (libblender_cpu_check.so not found).
installation_issues_and_workarounds.error: error while loading shared libraries: libblender_cpu_check.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
installation_issues_and_workarounds.root_cause: Sandbox environment policy on /working_dir rather than a toolkit defect; however, tools/doctor.py only reported 'Blender exited with code 127 without writing result JSON' without surfacing stderr inline.
installation_issues_and_workarounds.workaround: Extracted Blender 5.2.4 LTS tarball into /home/spark/opt/blender-5.2.4-linux-x64 and pointed BLENDER_EXECUTABLE there.
installation_issues_and_workarounds.proposed_improvement: Have shared/runner.py include the last few lines of stderr in the JSON error payload when Blender exits non-zero without writing result JSON.

installation_issues_and_workarounds.issue: README Quick Start uses `python` rather than `python3`, while Debian 12 only provides `python3` by default unless `python-is-python3` is installed.
installation_issues_and_workarounds.error: N/A (anticipated on Debian 12 and invoked python3 directly)
installation_issues_and_workarounds.proposed_improvement: Note `python3` for Linux/macOS in README Quick Start.
